assumptions: The budget envelope is denominated in burn UNITS; remaining/envelope dollars are derived from the week's own observed $/unit rate (usd_wtd / wtd.units), guarded against a zero-unit week. This is a model-mix-aware conversion, not a second price lookup.

The shared SpendEnvelopeVerdict shape in @harness-engineering/types stays unit-agnostic (it is also consumed by the orchestrator budget-governor); the $ overlay is a CLI-surface concern attached as a sibling `cost` key, not baked into the verdict.
The $ figure is derived ONLY when an adopter configures cost_price_table; there is no bundled Anthropic/provider pricing, keeping the primary number portable across model mixes. Default off / no-op.

Scope is the burn/fleet output only. The orchestrator engine budget-governor.ts (raw-token denominated, no summary) is out of scope. Cron scheduler (#1405) and dashboard-UI remain deferred slices of #1525 — closing keyword is `Refs #1525`, not `Closes`.
Summary.cost is additive/optional; existing summary consumers (statusline, hooks) ignore it and are byte-identical when no table is configured.
